adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.intro: Search accounts by name, open one to see its details, and suspend or reactivate it. Role changes are made in the database and recorded in the activity history.
adminUsers.results: {count, plural, =0 {No accounts match} one {# account} other {# accounts}}
adminUsers.limitNote: Showing the newest 200 matches. Narrow the search to find older accounts.
adminUsers.name: Name
adminUsers.emailNote: Use the email only to contact this person about their account.
adminUsers.suspendHelp: The person is signed out and can't use Maqsad until an admin reactivates the account. Their profile and credentials are hidden from other users meanwhile.
adminUsers.reactivateHelp: The person can sign in again and their profile becomes visible as before.
adminUsers.reasonHelp: Saved in the activity history. Describe the decision; don't include personal details or document contents.
adminUsers.done: Saved. The change is in the activity history.
adminUsers.adminNote: Admin accounts can't be suspended here.
adminUsers.selfNote: This is your own account. Another admin has to change its status.

errors.forbidden: Only active admins can do this.
errors.reason_required: Write a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
errors.cannot_change_self: You can't change the status of your own account.
errors.cannot_suspend_admin: Admin accounts can't be suspended here.
errors.not_available: This account isn't available. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.no_change: The account already has this status. Refresh the page.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

adminAudit.title: Activity history
adminAudit.intro: Account suspensions and reactivations, role changes and credential decisions, newest first. Entries can't be edited or deleted, and they hold no document contents.
